blocks.heading: Entry points
lines: Start with fixed placements: 'X is in team 1', 'X and Y are together'.
Then use sizes: a team of three with two people fixed has one place left.
Treat 'together or not at all' as one block of two people.

blocks.heading: Reading the rules
lines: 'If A, then B': A forces B. Read it backwards too: no B means no A.
'A only if B' means the same as 'if A, then B'.
'A and B cannot both be in': each one keeps the other out.
Chain rules: A forces B, and B keeps C out, so A keeps C out.

blocks.heading: Draw it
lines: Committees: names across the top, one line per case, a tick or cross under each name.
Teams: one column per team with empty slots to fill.
Split into cases on the person with the most rules attached.

blocks.heading: Counting cases
lines: Count cases that do not overlap, then add.
When teams have names, swapping two teams gives a different arrangement.
Check each case against every rule before you count it.

blocks.heading: Common traps
lines: Reading 'A only if B' as 'B only if A'.
Forgetting the size limits once a question adds a condition.
